doc.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: First records: Undercurrent Blues and Sam Most Plus Two
summary: His first 45 with Dick Hyman, and the 1954 session with Bellson and Percy Heath that Mingus issued on Debut.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When was the first opportunity to record for you?

Let me see when was the first. I had a friend, his name was Arnold Rosen and he was kind of like a pusher you know. He pushed me because he thought I was the next Benny Goodman you know, at the time. And so I think he might have been influential. I reckon the first one had Dick Hyman on piano. This is, I’m not sure, in 1952 or whatever it was, I did a little 45 with Dick Hyman and Clyde Lombardi, and Jackie Moffett I think. This was the personnel. That was a 45. That’s when 45s were around. And if I’m not mistaken I could have been on Prestige Records. But what did you ask me again?
That’s the one I’m talking about, yeah. Here and there I meet somebody that says “you know I have a copy of that ‘Undercurrent Blues.’” But I don’t know where my copy is.
If I can find one I’ll send it to you. They’re nice to have, don’t you think?
I believe so. I don’t remember it. It was a while back there.

I was playing flute. Yeah, I think maybe the whole record was a flute thing. And then shortly after that, well I think it was in 1954, I’m talking about this guy that was kind of pushing my career, we got into the studio and I don’t know exactly how it is, maybe he put up the money or I put up the money, we got a thing called “Sam Most Plus Two.” I don’t know if you’re familiar with that. That was a thing that Charlie Mingus put out on Debut Records. Now what happened was I had Louie Bellson on drums, Percy Heath and who else, Urbie Green and Bob Dorough and who else did we have there, I might be missing somebody, Doug Metamie on trumpet and Dave Schildkraut, Davie Schildkraut.
